function.name: create_script
function.description: Create or replace the named site object. Existing content may be overwritten; read it first before preparing a replacement. Use update_text_object for exact local text edits. Also creates or updates the supplied URL route for the object. Required top-level arguments: name (e.g. app.js), url (e.g. /app.js), content (complete JavaScript source). Send one JSON object containing all three; never send null, an empty object, or an arguments wrapper.

content.description: Required complete JavaScript source as a JSON string. Put content alongside name and url at the top level; do not send null or omit it.

url.description: Object route, e.g. `/about` or a dynamic Page route such as `/blog/{slug}`

name.description: Unique object name: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens or periods. Existing names are upserted.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
